rules.statement: A trustee under the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance can bring a partition suit when it is inexpedient to hold the land together with co-owners.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think the power which that section gives to trustees to sue for any other purpose requisite for carrying into effect the objects of the Ordinance ' is so wide that it would include the right of the trustee, when he finds that it is inexpedient to hold the land vested in him together with his other co-owners, to bring a partition suit under Ordinance No. 10 of 1863"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Ordinance No. 3 of 1889, s. 30; Ordinance No. 10 of 1863
